description_en: Obtains the qualification ID based on the ID of a qualification application ticket
description_zh: 通过资质申请工单号获取400号码的资质ID
name: GetHotlineQualificationByOrder

parameters.help_en:
The ticket ID.

You can log on to the Voice Messaging Service console (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/overview/home), choose Qualification\&Communication Script Management > Qualification Management, and then click the 400 Qualifications tab to view the ticket ID
parameters.help_zh:
工单号。

您可以在语音服务控制台400资质页面 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/qualification/400)查看工单号
parameters.name: order_id

Code.description_en:
The response code.

The value OK indicates that the request was successful.
For more information about other response codes, see [API error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。

返回OK代表请求成功。
其他状态码，请参见[错误码列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）

OrderId.description_en: The ID of the qualification application ticket

Status.description_en:
The qualification state. Valid values:

NORMAL
OTHER
Status.description_zh:
资质状态。取值：

NORMAL：正常状态。
OTHER：不正常状态
